text:
IncBot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-prod route=/v1/generate — p99 latency 1.3s, sustained >5m. PagerDuty incident: INC-67890, paging eng-oncall.
PagerDuty: Auto-escalation threshold reached (5m unacked). Notifying level-2.
Sanjay: ACK. I'm on call. pulling traces & logs now.
Emma: I'm available for mitigation. What's the scope — single region?
Sanjay: Metrics show EU-West and us-east both with p99 spikes, eu-west worse. p95 also elevated. Customer visible errors are latency-only (mostly 200s) and a few timed-out clients.
Liu: I can open a bridge. ops-sre, can you spin one up?
ops-sre: Bridge created: https://zoom.redwood/bridge/INC-67890. Joining.
Sanjay: Running quick queries to confirm tail:
```
# grafana prometheus query (approx)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",route="/v1/generate",env="prod"}[1m])) by (le))
# results: p99 ~ 1.2-1.4s, p95 ~ 420-480ms
```
Carlos: Any KV cache error spikes? kvcache hit ratio dropping?
Sanjay: Yes — kvcache eviction rate up, KV cache hit drops from 92% -> 61% over last 8m. Suspect thrash due to a burst of long-context requests.
Emma: Can we temporarily route latency-critical customers to the small-quantized variant (model: gpt-small-q4) to reduce token latencies?
Sanjay: Good plan. I'll push a routing override to route_group=latency-sensitive -> gpt-small-q4.
Liu: Also seeing autoscaler logs with repeated scale failures: error from provider api: quota exceeded during scale-up to new pods. Might be quota spike.
ops-sre: Quota confirmed — provisioning failed for 2 GPU nodes in eu-west. Workaround: start fallback to dedicated pool in us-east for overflow.
Sanjay: Executing mitigations: 1) add routing override 2) evict large KV entries on inference-prod 3) increase replica count where possible. Commands:
```bash
# route override (feature flag)
redwoodctl routing set override --route /v1/generate --target gpt-small-q4 --ttl 900
# scale deployment as allowed
kubectl scale deployment inference-prod --replicas=6 -n prod
# evict KV cache keys older than 30m (best-effort)
redis-cli -h kvcache.prod 'EVAL' "local keys=redis.call('keys', ARGV[1]) for i,k in ipairs(keys) do redis.call('del', k) end" 0 "kvcache:*:large"
```
Emma: Override applied, scaling started. Noted that autoscaler failed in eu-west — manual scale only for now.
Product-CX: We have 3 external support tickets reporting slow responses for realtime inference; one customer reported a 30s stall. Keeping them updated.
Sanjay: After override and partial scaling, p99 dropped to ~700-900ms in us-east, eu-west still 1.1-1.3s. Overall errors remain low (5xx ~0.2%). Continuing.
Carlos: I'm going to open a follow-up with infra for quota bump and look into why autoscaler couldn't provision. Assigning Infra owner: @Carlos.
ops-sre: I've queued a temporary bump request and filed a vendor ticket. Also restarting the autoscaler controller in eu-west to clear transient failures.
Liu: PagerDuty status: INC-67890 still active. Manual ack by Sanjay at this point?
Sanjay: ACKed in PagerDuty at 1729990120. Noting timeline in bridge.
Emma: Handing next 30 minutes to Emma for stabilization and canary traffic. Sanjay — you own immediate post-incident notes.
Sanjay: Will draft initial timeline and immediate mitigation actions, assigning postmortem owner Carlos.
Product-CX: Logged customer impact: 4 customers experienced degraded latency; one escalated; SLA tracker shows one SLO breach in rolling window.
Sanjay: Marking incident as mitigated — majority of traffic returned to baseline p95/p99 after routing override and manual scale. Closing the urgent escalation; keeping bridge open for follow-ups.
ops-sre: Closing bridge in 10m unless any objections.
Carlos: Postmortem ownership accepted. I'll coordinate detailed timeline, root cause (kvcache thrash + quota/autoscaler failure), and remediation (autoscaler retry hardening, request-rate shed, routing failover automation).
Emma: Leaving notes for handoff to next oncall. I'll follow up with a canary for the routing rollback plan.
Sanjay: Thanks all. Incident closed to active work. Please add any missing notes to the timeline in the incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-67890
